alt: Bar chart: an oil tested at 800 mg/kg of polyphenols keeps 464 and loses 336 in 12 months; an oil tested at 200 keeps 116 and loses 84, both at the 42% average loss measured across 160 oils
Timeline: freshness falls from the harvest, while the best-before date is stamped at bottling with a fixed 18 to 24 month window, so the printed date can sit on oil that is already three years old
Hands cupping a blue tasting glass of olive oil to warm it before smelling it
Onions softening in olive oil in a cast-iron pan on a gas flame, with a bottle of ATTIMO beside the stove
A bottle of ATTIMO Coratina on a dark cupboard shelf next to stoneware bowls and a jar of beans, with a thin strip of daylight through the open door
